interruption.injection_point: a fixture endpoint raises KeyboardInterrupt immediately after the canonical condition-start artifact is durably written
interruption.recovery: new experiment owner, same protocol/context identity and artifact root, reads the started condition and persists execution_incomplete without calling either endpoint
interruption.source_context: the same FrozenCausalContext built from exact resource-derived recovered history records and World-State current projection

limits: A test KeyboardInterrupt models interruption after the durable start boundary; it is not external process-kill or filesystem fault-injection evidence.
All A/B endpoints remain deterministic fixture endpoints; no production model transition or improvement claim.
